name: sgs/site-header-row
title: SGS Header Row
description: One row of a site header — an intrinsic never-overflow cluster of header elements (logo, nav, cart, etc.) that wraps rather than overflowing at any width. Lives inside sgs/site-header.

flexWrap._comment: D455 — the header row is locked to ONE line and yields instead of wrapping. 'wrap' was the default until the authored @container stack rule was deleted from style.css; with that gone, wrap would trade a stack for an ambiguous 2-per-line arrangement. Read by SGS_Container_Wrapper (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php:622). No header pattern sets flexWrap explicitly, so this default governs every instance.

gap._comment: D455 — DELIBERATELY NOT a clamp(), though the fit-cascade design called for one. sgs_container_gap_value() (helpers-container.php:124) sanitises this value through the allowlist /[^0-9a-z.% ]/, which strips parentheses, commas and +. A clamp() default emits as the invalid 'clamp0.5rem 0.25rem 1.5cqi 1rem' — the browser drops the declaration and the gap silently dies. Verified by running the real regex over the real string, not by reading the code. Widening that allowlist is a SHARED-helper change affecting every container block and needs its own design gate; parked, not forgotten. Fixed 16px is safe here because the yielding is carried by child shrink, not by the gap.
